scope: macOS notification permission, content-free reminders, sound choice and safe click navigation
implemented: UNUserNotificationCenter settings query and explicit user-enable authorization; the prior desktop plugin that returned Granted unconditionally was removed.
Defaults remain disabled and silent. Known system permission and sound/banner settings are displayed separately from Farfold preferences. Unknown or denied permission does not authorize submission.

Final submission holds the settings mutation gate and rechecks revision, preference, actual window focus and existing index. Late receipts after preference changes withdraw that exact notification; missing receipts never auto-retry.

OS payload contains generic Farfold wording and SHA256 of the existing metadata row ID. It contains no path, native session ID, title, draft or message. No extra persistent mapping or transcript ledger was added.

Default click queues an in-memory target, rechecks the existing metadata before consuming it, and focuses the app. Existing UI state is only selected. A cold index requires a second explicit history-open click and never automatically connects, recovers, approves or sends.
In-memory deduplication includes a random renderer nonce so WebView reload does not reuse earlier sequence keys.
